about: MeteoAlarm's portugal warning feed as a compact table: one line per CAP message in the feed at the time read, oldest sent first. The warnings are issued by the national service named in each line (`sender`); MeteoAlarm (EUMETNET) carries them. A dated record, not a live feed: read 2026-11-11T22:24:36Z. Time delays between this website and the www.meteoalarm.org website are possible. For the most up-to-date awareness information as published by the participating National Meteorological and Hydrological Services, please refer to www.meteoalarm.org. Not a warning service. Facts.
disclaimer: Time delays between this website and the www.meteoalarm.org website are possible. For the most up-to-date awareness information as published by the participating National Meteorological and Hydrological Services, please refer to www.meteoalarm.org.
licence: CC BY 4.0 with MeteoAlarm's additional terms for redistribution (sources/meteoalarm/source.json)

fields.uuid: MeteoAlarm's id for the message (its CAP XML is at cap_xml_of_one_message)
fields.sent_utc: when the national service issued it
fields.replaces: the message(s) it names in CAP references, with their sent time (the identifier normalised: IPMA sometimes writes it with a stray dash, kept as id_as_written)
fields.replaced_by: the later message in this feed that names this one in its references: this one is no longer in force, whatever its hours say
fields.event_national: the event in the national language
fields.h: first 16 hex of the sha256 of the message as JSON
